Aggregate ATT(g,t) cells to WATT(r) + Pre/Post averages

Source: R/aggregate_large.R
dot-aggregate_large.Rd

Aggregate ATT(g,t) cells to WATT(r) + Pre/Post averages

Usage

.aggregate_large(attgt, rolling)

Arguments

attgt

Data frame with columns g, t, r, att, ngt (one row per cell).

rolling

"demean" or "detrend" (controls the anchor periods).

Value

Data frame with columns effect, ryear, watt, n_cells, n_units. Rows: Pre_avg, Post_avg, then one row per relative period r (sorted). SE / t / p / CI columns are added later by the inference layer (Phase 2).
